proposals.title: A reading room that knows where you are
proposals.interaction: Scroll a small reading panel with a sticky chapter heading and chapter markers.
proposals.result: A stuck heading gains a clear “Reading” label; markers identify the current chapter and native buttons move between sections.
proposals.fallback: Keep native scrolling and chapter links when the scroll enhancements are unsupported. Verify scroll-state, marker and button support independently.

proposals.title: Which rule gets the last word?
proposals.interaction: Choose competing class, attribute and ID selectors for the same lounge invitation.
proposals.result: Show the winning declaration beside a three-part specificity score, so changing a selector explains the result.
proposals.fallback: Use ordinary selectors for the example; keep the score and winner available as text. Model importance, origin and layers separately from specificity.

proposals.title: One card, three kinds of welcome
proposals.interaction: Switch a named custom property between quiet, warm and high-contrast contexts on the parent.
proposals.result: A nested invitation changes its spacing and treatment through style queries, with the selected context named in text.
proposals.fallback: Show the base invitation if style queries are unavailable; verify the supported query syntax before implementation.

proposals.title: A note that stays close
proposals.interaction: Open a native reading-note popover beside a bookmark button, then move that button toward the edges of a contained preview.
proposals.result: The note follows its anchor and demonstrates alternate placements without covering the trigger.
proposals.fallback: Retain native popover dismissal and Escape; use a normal in-flow note where anchor positioning or popovers are unavailable.

proposals.title: Follow a good idea from room to room
proposals.interaction: Navigate between two real mini article pages with the same shared cover image.
proposals.result: The cover and title move into their new positions, connecting the collection view to the reading view.
proposals.fallback: Keep normal links and full page navigation; suppress motion for reduced-motion users. Verify same-origin cross-document transition requirements.

proposals.title: The same content, a better starting point
proposals.interaction: Compare an isolated browser-default article with an isolated minimal-reset version; switch between prose, form and image examples.
proposals.result: Reveal the effect of border-box sizing, sensible image defaults and inherited form typography while retaining useful browser behavior.
proposals.fallback: Isolate each comparison so reset rules cannot affect the Studio or homepage. Keep both examples readable without scripting.

proposals.title: Everything finds its line
proposals.interaction: Add a longer title or description to one of three editorial cards, then toggle shared row tracks.
proposals.result: Titles, descriptions and reading links align across nested cards even when their copy lengths differ.
proposals.fallback: Use independent grid cards as a readable fallback; avoid promising matching tracks where subgrid is unsupported.

proposals.title: See the space around the letters
proposals.interaction: Compare two large typographic specimens with visible cap-height and baseline guides; toggle trimming.
proposals.result: The trimmed specimen sits flush with its intended text edges while the untrimmed line box remains visible alongside it.
proposals.fallback: Review the article terminology before implementation: current documentation uses text-box-trim and text-box-edge. Unsupported browsers retain the original line box.

proposals.title: A welcome that never slips out of reach
proposals.interaction: Increase the number of items in a narrow, scrollable flex row and compare center with safe center.
proposals.result: Short rows stay centered; overflowing rows align from the start so the first item remains reachable.
proposals.fallback: Keep native horizontal scrolling and a start-aligned baseline. Label each alignment mode with text.

proposals.title: Build a palette from one warm note
proposals.interaction: Adjust the proportion of amber mixed into a forest-green surface; compare sRGB and OKLCH samples.
proposals.result: A set of related swatches, borders and buttons changes together, with proportions and resulting values shown.
proposals.fallback: Use fixed palette tokens when color-mix is unsupported. Check text contrast independently; a related palette is not automatically accessible.

proposals.title: Let the card describe its context
proposals.interaction: Add or remove an image from an editorial card, then inspect matching :has(), :is() and :where() rules.
proposals.result: The card responds to the image’s presence while a selector inspector explains what matched and how specificity differs.
proposals.fallback: Use a readable base card without :has(); preserve the inspector explanation and avoid equating :is() and :where() specificity.

proposals.title: A little more than auto
proposals.interaction: Open a reading-note disclosure, add another paragraph and compare intrinsic height with an adjusted intrinsic size.
proposals.result: The expanded frame follows its content and demonstrates a calculated amount of extra room instead of a guessed fixed height.
proposals.fallback: Treat calc-size() as an experimental enhancement. Use an ordinary auto-sized disclosure when unsupported, and respect reduced motion.

proposals.title: The same idea, scaled to its surroundings
proposals.interaction: Resize two independent cards side by side while keeping the browser width fixed.
proposals.result: Type, padding and small decorative details scale with each card through cqi units, bounded by clamp().
proposals.fallback: Retain rem-based spacing and type when container units are unavailable. Show each container’s measured width.

proposals.title: Set the order, settle the cascade
proposals.interaction: Reorder base, component and utility layers around a deliberately conflicting invitation style.
proposals.result: The winning style changes with layer precedence, accompanied by a short explanation of the rule that won.
proposals.fallback: Keep the example scoped; explicitly distinguish normal declarations, unlayered styles and the reversed ordering of important declarations.

proposals.title: A goodbye with a little grace
proposals.interaction: Open and close a small reading-note panel with a native button.
proposals.result: Opacity and discrete display changes cooperate so the panel can enter and leave smoothly without timeout-based removal.
proposals.fallback: Show an immediate, readable open/closed state without discrete transitions. Keep aria-expanded synchronized and remove motion when requested.

proposals.title: A whole list, one motion budget
proposals.interaction: Switch between batches of seven and forty notifications, then replay their entrance.
proposals.result: Only the first few items stagger; a capped delay keeps the final warning visible promptly in both batches.
proposals.fallback: Keep all notification text readable from the start. Use a static list for reduced motion or unsupported sibling-index(); animate decoration rather than hiding content.
